Hey guys, I want to start doing a weekly discussion, where we can talk about specific Survival Horror games. We will start out with the game "Lone Survivor", by Jasper Byrne... In the following weeks, we may either talk about mechanics, or ideas, or more games. If you have an idea for a weekly discussion, please shoot me a message.

So yes, this week we are talking about "Lone Survivor".

Lone Survivor is unusual mix of survival horror, stealth mechanics, adventure games, a virtual pet, a physical and psychological survival simulation and a truly interactive story. The player is encouraged to role-play and forget about the game's workings, while the story moulds to match the player's actions. This is a game where your choices genuinely matter.

Please tell us what you think of the game, why you think it is or is not Survival/Psychological horror, if you enjoyed it, why you like it, or why you haven't played it, what you didn't like about it. Really this is just a free for all discussion about the game.
